scenarios.name: Cancel browsing for a project workspace folder

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with `fixtures/cad/project-dialog-native/WizardProject.opj` as its first project
the user opens Projects from the template chooser, chooses New and advances to the project-file page
a workspace folder and project file location are displayed
the user chooses the workspace folder browse control
a folder browser opens with a folder tree and a Folder field
it offers Make New Folder, OK and cancels
the user selects Documents in the folder tree
Documents is selected and its child folders are displayed
the user chooses Cancel in the folder browser
the wizard still displays the previous workspace folder and project file location
the user cancels the project wizard
